page.layout: One printed page, single column of dictionary entries; running head "AS." centred at top; page number 67 at top right; signature/catchword "E 2" at foot left-centre and catchword "Assare]" at foot right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Aspectus] Obtutus Oculorum. Intuitus, Species, Conjectus oculorum, Cic. Respectu me terruit, Plaut. Inspectio, Col. Injectus oculorum, Arnob.
Aspectu tantum terret] Visu, non re terribilis.

Asper] Peraspep, Cels. Scaber cortex, Plin. Rugosus, Id. Scabrata vitis, Col. Scabrosus unguis. Scrupulosa cortex. Tergum ulceribus oftreatum, Plaut. Fragosus, Quint. Confragosus, Lucan. Squarosus, Lucill. Rigens. Scythâ asperior, Er. Rusco horridior, Id.
Asperè, propr.] Asperiter, Non. Scabrè, Robert. Stephan. Fragosè fragosiùs, Plin.

Aspere, translat.] Acutè dicere. Acriter. Acerrimè vituperare. Acerbè dicere. Vehementer aliquem accipere. Fastidiosè. Duriùs differere. Severè, Cic. Inclementer in aliquem dictum, Ter. Scrupulosè probare, Col. Infectanter vituperare, Gell.

Aspergere] Irrigare. Respergere, Cic. Perspergere, Tacit. Adaquare arbores, Plin. Offundere, Obsipare alicui aquam, Plaut. Irrorare aliquid oleo, Col. Tingere poculis, Hor. Inspergere vinum. Spargere saxa tabô, Cic.
Asperitas] Aspretum, Liv. Aspredo. Aspritudo, Cels. Scabricia cutis. Scabrities. Scabrum, Plin. Scabredo, Hieron. Salebra, Plaut. Scabies, Cic. Virg.

Aspernari] Despicere aliquem. Despicatui ducere aliquem. In minimis, in extremis res aliquas ponere. Pro nihilo ducere, habere, putare aliquid. Parvi ducere. Negligere minas alicujus. Nauci habere aliquem, Cic. vid. Contemnere.
Aspersio] Aspersus. Respersus. Respersio, Irrigatio, Cic. Riguum. Perfusio, Plin. Aspergo, inis. Sparsio aquæ, Sen.

Aspicere] Aspicere ad, aspicere inter se, Cic. Contemplari oculis. Contueri ad, Id. Conspicere aliquid lumine cupido, Catul. Spectare oculis devorantibus, Mart. Obtueri, Plaut. Pascere oculos, Ter. Adspectare aliquem, Cic. Respicere ad, Ter.
Aspis] Ceraftes, Plin. Excetra, Cic. Serpens cornutus, Stat.

page.notes: Scan is somewhat blurred; some words in the Greek-free Latin entries are uncertain, e.g. "Peraspep" (printed Perasper) and "Rusco" (printed Rusco) were copied as seen. Long s written as plain s throughout.
